data.repairedMid: I'd like to talk about a lake outside the city that I visited a few years ago with my cousins. It's about two hours from where I live, so we usually goes on a Saturday morning. What I really enjoy is that it's so peaceful compared with the city, which can get quite stressful. We normally rent a small boat and just drift around, and then we have lunch at a little restaurant by the water. The last time I went, it rained halfway through, but we stayed anyway, which was actually fun. I'd say the main reason I like it is that it helps me switch off from work, so I come back feeling much more relaxed than when I left.
